body:
ARCHITECTURE SKETCH (STORY-1688) is posted as the latest comment on STORY-1688 (aida show STORY-1688 --comments). PR #2743 fixer (claude), worktree ~/ai/aida-worktrees/fix-2743.
- No comment-text parsing. FACTORY READY becomes green required checks at head via gh statusCheckRollup. The operator gate becomes .aida/merge-holds plus the MergeHoldChanged ts. The advisor gate becomes an unanswered mailbox request (intent=request).
- Relay lanes are left to relay-stall. Fixture-override JSON inputs are removed.
- The headless record is keyed on lease_id. It persists on ANY exit while the lease is held, is re-validated every tick, and is GC'd when the lease or spec is done or after 24h. A deliberately halted drain is not a lane.
- Ships enabled=false, plus a 24h orphan age window that excludes terminal specs. Test: 21 old leases plus 1 fresh one gives 1 finding.
- Exits 0 after routing, so the lane-liveness-route job is deleted (one route per finding). Seats are advisor and reviewer only, validated against AGENT_ROLES. The operator gets notify only. Prompts come from one const ROUTES, with no config.toml copies.
- Ids are keyed on lease_id / PR@sha8 / msg id. All three criteria are traced, and the replays run through production writers.
- TASK-2003 is NOT folded in; reason in section 7.
FORK for you: is the advisor-gate source the mailbox (recommended), or do we drop that check from slice 1? I'm waiting for your signoff before writing code.
subject: STORY-1688 sketch ready
